name: 0.40mm Non-planar top @BBL A1M 0.8 nozzle
description: 0.40mm Standard for A1 mini with a 0.8 mm nozzle, curved top shells; auto chooses the shell count (2 to 6) and pattern for each curved area, with ironing left off. Thin curved parts (up to 3 mm) print in curved layers throughout on meshes with holes; closed meshes keep planar interiors. Uses the bundled bambu-a1-mini-nozzle-08 head.
